_approach: The jazzier end of the sound: heavy swing (0.22, near the 65% ceiling melodigging quotes for a 'laid-back pocket'), a tambourine timekeeper instead of a shaker, and the perc slot carrying syncopated horn-stab hits rather than a plain backbeat clap. Kicks drop beat 3 (the falling-forward template) so the horns have room to land. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
